audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side read Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Skill/Irelia while the content win[] row reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Irelia/Irelia/Karma and the packet levelChart agrees with content. The page renders two different answers per row.
audit.why: Karma's 950-range Inner Flame and 675 Focused Resolve outrange Bladesurge (600) before minions are dense enough to reset it; Irelia takes over at 6 with Vanguard's Edge (950) cutting the retreat of a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: Align phases[].side to the content/packet chart; rewrite phases[4].why and phases[5].why so the sentence agrees with the Irelia verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and content.mid all attribute 'true damage and tenacity' to 'Ionian Fervor (R)'. Ionian Fervor is Irelia's PASSIVE (stacking attack speed, bonus on-hit at max stacks); her R is Vanguard's Edge.
audit.why: Riot's text in enemyKit: P = stacking Attack Speed; R = blades that damage, Mark and then form a damaging slowing wall.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike is Vanguard's Edge: Marks for a Bladesurge reset and walls off the retreat of a dashless Karma.

audit.whatIsWrong: No statement of the decisive interactions: Flawless Duet grounds (denies dashes) and stuns between two converging blades; Bladesurge refreshes on a Marked or dying target; Vanguard's Edge terrain cuts the retreat of a champion with no dash; Bladesurge heals per strike.
audit.why: All four are in the kit flags/text and none reach the page.
audit.corrected: Stated across breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, phases[4].why and spikes[1].text; Flash is held for the wall, not the damage; Grievous Wounds is called out against Bladesurge sustain.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Flawless Duet 16s rank 1 / 10s rank 5; Bladesurge 10s with refresh; Vanguard's Edge 125s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: 16 misgendered fields calling Irelia he/his/him; two copy-paste-bleed bullets (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad).
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists irelia as female; the bullets' titles promise different content than their bodies.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; both bleed bullets replaced with kit-grounded content matching their titles.
